text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, I find Director Akikawa growing turf for the racecourse in her field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way one person could ever grow that much turf by themselves… but with everyone's help, it's another story!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans, Umamusume, and trainers alike all pitch in to make the event happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This amazing turnout could only be made possible by Director Akikawa's infectious love for Umamusume.
